legacy.title: Decades of Experience. Built for What's Next

drives.title: Every Decision Starts With What Matters
drives.p1Desc: We think about how people live, work, connect, and enjoy every day.
drives.p2Desc: From location to layout and amenities, every choice is made for a reason.
drives.p3Desc: We focus on quality, careful execution, and value that lasts beyond today.
drives.p4Desc: We create for changing lifestyles, new possibilities, and the way people will live tomorrow.

founder.title: Building Dubai's Next Era of Living
founder.p1: With more than 18 years of experience across Dubai and international real estate markets, Ajmal Saifi has learned to see real estate beyond the building itself.
founder.p2Lead: For him, every development begins with a deeper question:
founder.p2Strong: what will make this place meaningful to the people who live there - today, and years from now?
founder.p4: His approach brings together the right location, thoughtful design, quality execution, and a clear understanding of how people want to live. The goal is not simply to create beautiful homes, but to create places that feel considered, add value to everyday life, and remain relevant over time.
founder.p5Lead: As Prestige One continues to grow, Ajmal's vision remains clear:
founder.p5Strong: to build with purpose, protect quality, and create a name people trust for what it stands for.
founder.quote: "True prestige is not simply seen. It is felt, lived, and remembered."

journey.title: From Experience to Creation
journey.m1Text: Prestige Holding Group is established, beginning a business journey built over decades.
journey.m2Text: Prestige enters Dubai's real estate market, beginning a new chapter of investment and growth.
journey.m3Text: Prestige begins expanding its real estate investments across key Dubai communities, building a growing portfolio across the city.
journey.m4Text: Prestige expands into land acquisitions across Dubai freehold communities, opening the way for future development.
journey.m5Text: Ajmal Saifi is recognised by Dubai Land Department as one of Dubai's top property investors.
journey.m6Text: Prestige One enters a new chapter as a developer, turning years of market experience into developments of its own.
journey.m7Text: Prestige One becomes the first regional real estate sponsor of the Argentina National Team.
journey.m8Text: Prestige One strengthens its international presence through globally recognised partnerships, with Dubai at the heart of its developments.
journey.m9Text: Prestige One reaches a major milestone with project handovers, while continuing to grow through new developments and global partnerships.
